digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate model escalation and window sizing
propositions: For a non-Anthropic-family primary model, models_at_or_above() returns the entire MODEL_LADDER instead of the primary itself because substring matching against Anthropic names fails and falls through to the fallback
Context-limit escalation downgrades to a smaller-window model (claude-haiku-4-5) on a different provider family, violating operator configuration intent

largest_window_tokens() returns MODEL_LADDER[-1][1] for unlocated primaries, overstating the context window budget and causing silent under-blocking and truncation instead of explicit too-big rejection
Prerequisites-coverage escalation at prerequisites.py:260-261 inherits the same defect and crosses provider families when the primary is unlocated

The fix returns [model] for truthy-but-unlocated primaries in models_at_or_above() and min(ladder windows) in largest_window_tokens(), preserving single-criterion retry and emitting honest _too_big findings
